title: AI Outbound Follow-Up Caller for Lead Re-engagement
summary: A voice agent that phones leads, works out whether they want an estimate call, a later callback or nothing at all, and updates the CRM automatically.
headline: AI that phones your leads for you
problem: Following up with cold or stalled leads by phone was manual, repetitive work, and the outcomes were not always recorded consistently.
solution: I built an outbound agent that behaves like a calm internal team member, not a pushy sales bot. n8n pulls the leads, triggers the calls through ElevenLabs and Twilio, handles voicemail, and writes the outcome back to the CRM: schedule an overview call, reconnect later or not interested.
highlights: Short, natural calls with strict conversational guardrails
Detects intent: book, call back later, or not interested
CRM status updated automatically from the call outcome
role: Sole engineer. I wrote the voice agent prompt and guardrails, built the n8n workflows that fetch leads and place calls, and connected call outcomes back to the CRM.

results.label: Leads re-engaged by phone without manual dialling
Every call outcome recorded in the CRM automatically
